content.title: About
content.content: Clif Kids Organic Zbar is an organic energy bar designed specifically for children. It contains whole grains, organic fruits and nuts, as well as plant‑based protein, providing balanced nutrition for active play and school.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The bar is USDA Organic certified, guaranteeing no synthetic pesticides or GMOs.
Made with whole oat flakes, organic apple juice and cranberry for natural flavor without artificial additives.
Each bar provides 6 g of plant protein from soy isolate and nuts.
Free from gluten, dairy, and artificial colors, making it suitable for kids with common food sensitivities.
Packaging is made from recyclable material, supporting environmental responsibility.

items.title: Source of whole grains
items.content: Oat flakes deliver complex carbohydrates that release energy slowly, helping maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and B6 support normal energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Organic cranberries and apple juice are high in polyphenols, which help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Plant protein
items.content: 6 g of protein contributes to growth and muscle repair in children.

items.title: Low added sugar
items.content: Sweetness comes from natural fruit juices rather than refined sugar.

items.title: Nut and soy allergy
items.content: The bar contains nuts and soy isolate, which may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Calorie density
items.content: Despite its nutritious ingredients, the bar is relatively calorie‑dense; portion control is recommended.

items.title: High fiber content
items.content: Large amounts of fiber can cause digestive discomfort in children with sensitive stomachs if consumed in excess.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bar is convenient to take to school, on a hike, or to the gym. Eat it as a standalone snack or crumble it into yogurt, oatmeal, or a smoothie for an extra energy boost.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bars in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal the package tightly or transfer bars to an airtight container to maintain crispness.
